contract.task_clause:
Many cryptographic protocols base their security on assumptions about the computational difficulty of integer factorization. Integer factorization serves this purpose because we believe that
Option A: integer multiplication is a function whose inverse, factorization, remains difficult for a large class of inputs
Option B: P = NP
Option C: even if P = NP, integer factorization is still likely not to be polynomial-time computable
Option D: testing primality is computationally intractable
